notes: Closed a real gap where a foreign manufacturer (confirmed Indian, via its own .co.in website) still showed up in a Europe-only report just because its site also mentioned some European countries as places it ships to. The rule now is: a company confirmed based outside the target region is dropped, even if it also exports there - a Europe report should mean Europe-based companies. Verified against a real test run: this correctly removed 2 more Indian companies without affecting any genuinely European or genuinely unclear ones. Reminder: if a run still looks thin or off for a market, first check that your DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in .env is a valid, working key.
